summary: Iteration 18 multi-tenant SaaS verification. RESULTS: FLOW 1 (fresh Shop Admin auto-provision) PASS — signup screen has no role segmented control (only name/shop-name/email/password), fresh signup routes to /(tabs)/dashboard (NOT /super-admin nor /subscription-locked), Settings header shows 'Shop Admin', /admin panel loads. FLOW 2 (Shop A adds tyre) PASS — BridgestoneA A-1 saved under shops/<shopA>/tyres and visible in Car inventory (verified via screenshot showing '1 SKUs' and 'BridgestoneA · A-1 · 185/65 R15 · Buy ₹3,000 · Sell ₹4,000 · Qty 8'). FLOW 3 (Shop B tenant isolation) PASS — fresh signup for Shop B routed to a NEW empty inventory ('No tyres yet, Add your first SKU'), BridgestoneA NOT visible in Shop B, CeatB B-1 195/55 R16 was successfully added under Shop B. Tenant isolation via tenantCol/tenantDoc holds. FLOW 4 (Super Admin panel) PASS — signup with superadmin@tyrebook.test routed to /super-admin (whitelist works), header shows 'Super Admin · 4 shops · superadmin@tyrebook.test' with KPI pills (Trial 3 · Active 1 · Expired 0 · Suspended 0), Shop A Test listed with Trial badge, tap opens detail page with owner email/UID/shopId/status/trial-end date and 6 subscription actions (Extend trial 14d, Renew 30 days, Renew 1 year, Suspend, Activate, Mark expired). FLOW 5 (subscription lifecycle) PASS — Mark expired flipped Shop A to 'Expired', shop_a login was correctly redirected to /subscription-locked showing 'Subscription expired' heading, 'Shop A Test', shopId 'shop-a-test', Status 'Expired', with only 'Open Settings' + 'Logout' available. Renew 30 days flipped status back to 'Active' with Plan expires '06 Sept 2026'. FLOW 6/7 (staff invite + regression): NOT COMPLETED end-to-end due to a post-renew login race where the second Shop A login landed on /login instead of /dashboard (my automation timing); the invite UI itself (/admin/users with invite-email + send-invite-btn testIDs) was verified to render correctly during earlier hop. Two observations for E1: (a) Shop B's shop name showed as 'shop.a+<epoch>'s Tyre Shop' in the super-admin list instead of 'Shop B Test' — likely React Native web onChangeText not firing when playwright fill()s the second signup's shop-name input; needs manual re-verification but could be an AppTextField controlled-state quirk (defaultValue vs value binding). (b) Shop detail page displays 'Created: Invalid Date' — the shops.createdAt Firestore Timestamp is not being converted to a Date before .toLocaleDateString(); should use shop.createdAt?.toDate?.() ?? new Date(shop.createdAt).

ui_bugs.issue: Shop detail card displays 'Created: Invalid Date' for both Shop A Test and (implicitly) other shops. shops.createdAt is likely a Firestore Timestamp (or a serverTimestamp() placeholder on the freshly-provisioned shop) but the render uses new Date(shop.createdAt).toLocaleDateString(...) directly. Fix: `const created = shop.createdAt?.toDate ? shop.createdAt.toDate() : shop.createdAt ? new Date(shop.createdAt) : null;` and guard the format call. Reference: /app/frontend/app/super-admin/shop/[id].tsx

When Playwright fill()s the shop-name input on a SECOND signup within the same browser context, the shop is created with the email-prefix fallback name ('shop.a+<epoch>\'s Tyre Shop') instead of the entered 'Shop B Test'. First signup with Shop A worked correctly. Likely AppTextField's underlying controlled TextInput swallows the initial fill event after re-mount. Suggest verifying AppTextField uses value/onChangeText (controlled) not defaultValue, and re-testing manually. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AppTextField.tsx, /app/frontend/app/(auth)/signup.tsx:47

integration_issues.issue: Doing `page.goto('/inventory/car')` immediately after a Save Tyre triggers a brief 'No active shop selected. Sign in as a Shop Admin or Staff…' console warning from tenantCol requireShopId, because the inventory screen mounts before AuthContext has re-hydrated setActiveShopId() on the fresh page load. The tyre IS saved successfully and visible after a normal in-app navigation (post-save router.back()). This is the same auth-hydration race pattern from iterations 16-17. Consider gating tenantCol calls behind `useAuth().loading === false` in list screens, or having tenant.ts also hydrate from AsyncStorage on module init. Reference: /app/frontend/src/firebase/tenant.ts:69, /app/frontend/app/inventory/[category].tsx (listTyres call site)

action_items: MAIN AGENT (E1) — LOW: In /app/frontend/app/super-admin/shop/[id].tsx, the shop detail card shows 'Created: Invalid Date'. Convert Firestore Timestamp / serverTimestamp() safely: `const createdAt = shop.createdAt?.toDate?.() ?? (typeof shop.createdAt === 'number' ? new Date(shop.createdAt) : null);` then only call toLocaleDateString when createdAt is a valid Date.

MAIN AGENT (E1) — MEDIUM: Verify that AppTextField's TextInput is controlled (value={value} onChangeText={setValue}) — during automated 2nd signup, the shop-name field appears to fall through to the email-prefix fallback ('shop.a+<epoch>\'s Tyre Shop') instead of the entered 'Shop B Test'. Manually re-run signup as Shop B and confirm the shop shows up under its intended name in Super Admin. If AppTextField is defaultValue-driven, switch to value/onChangeText.

MAIN AGENT (E1) — MEDIUM: Cover the tenant.ts activeShopId race on cold-reload of tenant-scoped screens (inventory/[category], sales, khata, purchase, etc.). Currently a hard refresh throws 'No active shop selected.' until AuthContext re-hydrates. Options: (a) subscribeActiveShopId → hydrate from storage.getItem(SHOP_KEY) synchronously at module init, OR (b) have every list screen gate its data fetch on useAuth().loading === false. Same class of bug as iterations 16-17.

MAIN AGENT (E1) — INFO: FLOWS 6 (staff invite consumption) and 7 (regression cross-tenant leak from staff) were NOT fully exercised end-to-end due to time; the invite UI (invite-email, send-invite-btn testIDs) renders and Shop A admin can reach /admin/users. Please self-test flow 6 manually — sign up with a fresh invited email and confirm the new account lands on Shop A's dashboard with Settings header 'Staff · <email>' and no 'Owner Admin Panel' row, and /admin URL redirects to /(tabs)/settings.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/firebase/tenant.ts:69 — requireShopId() throws synchronously when activeShopId is null. That's correct by design, BUT combined with page.goto style hard-reloads it produces a brief window where tenant-scoped list screens throw before AuthContext hydrates. Consider hydrating activeShopId synchronously from storage at module init (same pattern used in AuthContext).

/app/frontend/src/firebase/auth.ts:293-320 — Fresh-signup shop provisioning is clean and idempotent. `hydrateAppUser` step 4 uses `opts.fallbackName || "${email.split('@')[0]}'s Tyre Shop"`. When automation misses to propagate the shop-name field value, the fallback kicks in — this is defensive but hides the input-binding bug (see ui_bugs above).

/app/frontend/app/super-admin/shop/[id].tsx (Created row) — Displays 'Invalid Date'. Firestore serverTimestamp() returns FieldValue on write and a Timestamp on read; direct `new Date(shopObj.createdAt)` will not work for Timestamp instances. Use `.toDate?.()`.

/app/frontend/app/subscription-locked.tsx — Correctly gates the tenant post-expiry: only 'Open Settings' and 'Logout' surfaced, shop name + shopId + Status + Trial-end date all present. Verified in-lock screenshot.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The multi-tenant refactor is largely functional. Tenant isolation, super-admin routing, subscription lock, and role labels all work. Three concrete issues to close: (1) 'Invalid Date' on super-admin/shop/[id] Created row (Timestamp conversion), (2) shop-name signup input value not propagating on repeated automated signups (may or may not be a real bug in AppTextField binding — reproduce manually), (3) tenant.ts activeShopId race on hard-reload of list screens (same class as iterations 16-17). For flow 6 (staff invite), the pending-invite UI is present at /admin/users with testIDs invite-email and send-invite-btn — a follow-up run should reproduce: as Shop Admin invite a fresh staff email → logout → sign up with that email → confirm the account lands on the SAME shop's dashboard, Settings shows 'Staff · <email>', /admin URL redirects to Settings, and BridgestoneA (Shop A tyre) is visible but CeatB (Shop B) is NOT. Emails persisted at /tmp/tenant_emails.txt for reuse.
rca_of_issue: RCA (Invalid Date): shops.createdAt is a Firestore Timestamp / serverTimestamp() FieldValue, but the render path in super-admin/shop/[id].tsx passes it directly to `new Date(...)` which yields Invalid Date for Timestamp objects. RCA (shop-name not propagating on 2nd signup): the AppTextField may be binding the shop-name field via defaultValue or the state may be preserved across signup mounts, causing playwright's fill() to write to DOM without dispatching onChangeText. RCA (No active shop on hard-reload): activeShopId lives in a JS module singleton in tenant.ts that resets to null on each page load; setActiveShopId is only called from AuthContext after Firebase's onAuthStateChanged fires (~2-4 seconds), during which any list screen mounting will hit requireShopId() and throw. Fix: initialize activeShopId synchronously from storage.getItem(SHOP_KEY) at module load, OR have all tenant-scoped list screens gate their data fetch on useAuth().loading === false.
